'''Eisek''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3640 BBY]] he was the [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] of the [[Harrower-class dreadnought]] ''[[Doombringer]]'', which was used by Moff [[Valion Pyron]] to install and test the [[Silencer (superweapon)|Silencer]] superlaser. Before the testing, he received a message from Captain [[Joris]] of [[Darth Achelon]]'s flagship ''[[Carnage]]'', who requested aid.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Captain Eisek appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Sith Inquisitor class mission.
